characters.summary: Older, heavily armored Batman who relies on an exo-skeleton to maintain mobility, commanding an army of Bat-Robots and utilizing advanced tactical defense and surveillance networks.
weaknesses: Degraded physical health and spinal injury requiring mechanical assistance
limitations: Dependent on mechanical exo-skeleton due to advanced age and physical disability
characters.formDifferences: Batman is older, suffers from a severe spinal injury that necessitates an advanced mechanical exo-skeleton to walk and fight, and commands an automated Bat-Army.

sources.supports: Kingdom Come Batman exo-skeleton and physical condition

unknowns: Exact peak capabilities of the exo-skeleton compared to standard prime Batman.

characters.summary: A terrifying amalgamation of Batman and the Joker from the Dark Multiverse who possesses Batman's tactical genius combined with the Joker's sadistic madness and access to Nth metal weaponry.
weaknesses: Arrogance and psychological instability stemming from the Joker persona
limitations: Psychotic impulses occasionally override optimal tactical execution
characters.formDifferences: Replaces standard moral constraints and sanity with Joker insanity, gaining access to Dark Multiverse resources and infected sidekicks.
